params.body:
Correction to #146. The follow-up section said that `ELIXIR_CONTROL_PRINCIPAL_KEY` in the box's crontab was exposed and should be rotated. It is Portal's public key, the same value the DID log publishes as `#portal` (the Ed25519 `x` decodes to the same hex), so it is not a secret and needs no rotation.

Also records the rest of the follow-up as done: elixir #240 merged and active since the tunnel restart, and the gcloud SDK on the box updated from 583.0.0 to 588.0.0.

Documentation only.
